parameters.query:
WITH company_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    d.id,
    d.order_number,
    d.customer_name,
    d.customer_phone,
    d.delivery_address,
    d.total_amount,
    d.quantity,
    d.status,
    d.created_at,
    d.driver_id,
    -- Get driver info
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', dr.id,
      'name', dr.name,
      'phone', dr.phone,
      'vehicle_type', dr.vehicle_type,
      'license_plate', dr.license_plate,
      'rating', dr.rating,
      'current_location', 
        CASE 
          WHEN dr.current_latitude IS NOT NULL THEN 
            jsonb_build_object('lat', dr.current_latitude, 'lng', dr.current_longitude)
          ELSE NULL
        END
    ) as driver_info,
    -- Get cart info
    (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', c.id,
          'cart_number', c.cart_number,
          'total', c.total,
          'items_count', c.total_items
        )
      )
      FROM deliverymodule_delivery_cart_cart dcdc
      JOIN cart c ON dcdc.cart_id = c.id
      WHERE dcdc.delivery_id = d.id
    ) as carts
  FROM deliverymodule_delivery d
  LEFT JOIN deliverymodule_driver dr ON d.driver_id = dr.id
  WHERE d.company_id = $1::uuid
    AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND ($2::text IS NULL OR d.status = $2)
    AND ($3::date IS NULL OR DATE(d.created_at) >= $3)
    AND ($4::date IS NULL OR DATE(d.created_at) <= $4)
  ORDER BY d.created_at DESC
  LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6
)
SELECT 
  co.*,
  COUNT(*) OVER() as total_count
FROM company_orders co
